headline: As of 2026-10-20: 13,758,175 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 42 of 50 states, D+16.7 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 13,758,175 early/mail ballots cast so far across 42 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+16.7 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,716,890), Florida (1,375,276), Georgia (1,166,589).
